body:
Tested locally, it works as expected.

While I didn't get a crash on my end when following the steps in https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/102277 (Linux), this resolves error spam that previously occurred when assigning a fog shader to a property expecting a particle shader.


Looks fine. It seems to use the same logic as the Compatibility renderer version of this function.
